business_problem: Holland America Line wanted to provide even faster, more personalized support for customers—without driving up contact center volumes or running a traditional chatbot.
solution_summary: Holland America Line used Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Dataverse to support customer and agent interactions with AI-assisted automation. Holland America Line wanted to provide even faster, more personalized support for customers—without driving up contact center volumes or running a traditional chatbot. Key implementation elements included Microsoft Copilot Studio builds the digital concierge or voice agent that handles customer requests across channels; Microsoft Dynamics 365 provides the common business process layer that standardizes operations; Dataverse stores structured app data, conversation logs, and feedback for the service; Azure Monitor tracks platform health and operational telemetry.
